title: PatchedDataWarehouseSavedQuery
description:
Shared methods for DataWarehouseSavedQuery serializers.

This mixin is intended to be used with serializers.ModelSerializer subclasses.

name.description: Unique name for the view. Used as the table name in HogQL queries and the node name in the data modeling Node.

query.description: HogQL query definition as a JSON object with a "query" key containing the SQL string and a "kind" key containing the query type. Example: {"query": "SELECT * FROM events LIMIT 100", "kind": "HogQLQuery"}

status.description:
The status of when this SavedQuery last ran.

* `Cancelled` - Cancelled
* `Modified` - Modified
* `Completed` - Completed
* `Failed` - Failed
* `Running` - Running

folder_id.description: Optional folder ID used to organize this view in the SQL editor sidebar.

folder_name.description: Folder name used to organize this view in the SQL editor sidebar.

edited_history_id.description: Activity log ID from the last known edit. Used for conflict detection.

soft_update.description: If true, skip column inference and validation. For saving drafts.

dag_id.description: Optional DAG to place this view into

origin.description:
Where this SavedQuery is created.

* `data_warehouse` - Data Warehouse
* `endpoint` - Endpoint
* `managed_viewset` - Managed Viewset

is_test.description: Whether this view is for testing only and will auto-expire.

expires_at.description: When this test view should be automatically deleted.

user_access_level.description: The effective access level the user has for this object
